case.title: Iraq consultation summary workshop (fictional)
case.brief: Agree on a format for recording a simulated consultation about a mission review. The workshop leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched. Choose a package every participant can accept, or establish an impasse by recording a checked exclusion for every package. All packages and private mandates are fictional and carry no official commitments.
case.draft: Publish attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note.

options.public: Publish attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note.
options.aggregate: Publish only a consolidated note with no attributed submissions.
options.hybrid: Publish a consolidated note and send an attributed annex to the consultation participants only.
options.closed: Send attributed summaries to participants only and publish no consolidated note.
